name: Historical Void Projection
desc: Summon phantoms of entities or objects from past epochs.

name: Error Theft
desc: Steal physical concepts, time, or thoughts from the target.

name: Spirit Body Threads
desc: Control enemies like marionettes by pulling their spiritual tethers.

name: Madness Inducement
desc: Viewing the Titan's true form causes immediate psychological collapse.

name: Shadow Manifestation
desc: Solidify shadows into autonomous beasts or lethal weaponry.

name: True Name Command
desc: Absolute authority over any being whose true name is spoken.

name: Flaw Exploitation
desc: Instantly perceive and strike the conceptual weak point of anything.

name: Blood Crystallization
desc: Weaponize spilled blood by freezing it into ultra-hard spikes.

name: Vector Manipulation
desc: Control the magnitude and direction of any kinetic force.

name: Infinite Convergence
desc: Divide space infinitely so attacks never actually reach the user.

name: Path Transcendence
desc: Perceive the past, present, and future across a genetic lineage.

name: Causality Reversal
desc: Strike first, then let reality rewrite the cause of the wound.

name: Reactive Adaptation
desc: Develop immunity to any attack type after surviving it once.

name: Biomass Assimilation
desc: Absorb organic matter to rapidly heal or grow new appendages.

name: Chitinous Carapace
desc: Layered armor that disperses blunt force and thermal shock.

name: Pheromone Override
desc: Emit gas that completely pacifies pure Titans in a 5km radius.

name: Bone Protrusion
desc: Can snap own bones to use as crude blades. Highly painful.

name: Minor Friction Reduction
desc: Slightly slide across solid ground.

name: Elevated Core Temp
desc: User is constantly feverish. Melts standard ice.
